SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild (CVPR 2026)
	





	
		
	
	
		📢 News
	



 October 3, 2026: Hand pose v3 release: Significantly reduced joint angle limit violations, and increased valid frames. Now available in UmeTrack, MANO, and MHR. See hand_pose/README.md.
September 26, 2026: Updated 54 scenes in hand_pose/v2: re-tracked three with the correct hand profile, and in the other 51, kept hands that align with the images on frames with a repaired headset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/show3d-dataset.
